lines: Anaykumar Avinash Joshi (Promoter) holds 591,000 shares, valued at about ₹79.90 crore (estimate, at offer price), and is not selling in this offer. These are shares, not cash, and the holding is medium confidence since it is not in the seller table.

Timing is the reason to call now: shares forming the Minimum Promoters' Contribution (20% of fully diluted post-Offer capital) are locked in for 18 months from Allotment, and promoter shares above that 20% for six months from Allotment.
Proceeds and gain are not applicable because he is not in the seller table.
Family link: unknown; the fields do not record one.
